scope: Exactly 57 assigned single-prefix ANTH/SOCI/INGS identifiers; every complete public course card was opened and read. No prerequisite-chain expansion or identity merger. Semester unit convention follows the separately reviewed RIT D01.4 policy; all 57 credit amounts were independently printed on their own cards. Runtime observations do not emit manual taxonomy reviews.

notes: No prerequisite field is published in this inspected card; this does not establish unrestricted enrollment.
